in_marathi.name: Dhananjay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory through wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhananjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhananjay is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'dhan' meaning wealth and 'anjaya' meaning one who conquers or victorious. In Hindu mythology, Dhananjay is an epithet for Arjuna, one of the Pandava brothers and a central character in the Mahabharata.
